curation.name: Microduck Step-Up
curation.summary: Perpetual walk-slot policy for ascending a 25 mm square-edged household step; simulation-validated and hardware-unvalidated per its manifest.
curation.details: Standing-entry policy trained on Mjlab-StepUpFull-MicroDuck (checkpoint 1000) with an unused zero command block. The publisher notes the policy does not detect the step itself; the richer two-policy step-up plus head-brake recovery package is published separately.
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; action_scale is not declared so installation needs review. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher manifest describes the policy as simulation-validated and hardware-unvalidated.
